data.source_text_main_point: In retaliation for the FBI's shutdown of the file-sharing site Megaupload and proposed anti-piracy laws, the hacker group Anonymous launched a massive coordinated cyberattack that took down the websites of the US Justice Department, FBI, and major record labels.

actors.name: Anonymous
variations: members of online activist group Anonymous

statements.key_statement: The FBI seized the Megaupload website and arrested its operators for copyright infringement and money laundering.
statements.long_statement: On Thursday, the Federal Bureau of Investigation executed the seizure and shutdown of the Megaupload website, resulting in the arrest of the site's founder and six other individuals on charges including copyright infringement, racketeering, and conspiracy to commit money laundering. Authorities stated that these legal actions were necessary to dismantle an operation that had cost the entertainment industry hundreds of millions of dollars in damages through unauthorized distribution of copyrighted material.
